entry_policy: v8:structural (function tier); class tier only if no function entry, flagged rename_invariant=False
PYTHONHASHSEED: 0 (fixed for the test scoring; v8 dev scoring was shown independent of the seed: 0/1/7 identical)

tau_v8.derived_on: v8 DEV only (13 programs after the stale-variant exclusion)

weights.note: learned_m1/m2 are secondary; sbg_v5 fixed weights 0.50/0.25/0.25 is the primary predictor

validity_audit.caveat: static observability audit using the v7 entry rule applied to v8 pairs; no v8-specific audit

pre_declared_exclusion.rule: 8 programs whose committed variants do not match their current base file (base edited after variant generation) are excluded from evaluation; content-only rule, 4 of them are test programs (math_count_set_bits, math_gcd_lcm, math_nthroot_newton, math_power_modular; 163 test pairs)

statistics.ci: cluster bootstrap by base program, 2000 resamples, seed 42
statistics.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni over the 6 baselines (edit_size_reversed, exception_fraction, call_count, coverage_size, static_ast, static_token)
statistics.stratified: exact canonical edit-size strata, cluster bootstrap

pre_declared_success_criterion: SBG V5 beats the best baseline INCLUDING reversed edit size with a delta-AUROC 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND its exact-edit-size-stratified AUROC exceeds the label-shuffle p95; otherwise reported as NOT DEMONSTRATED

test_split.run_policy: single run; evaluate_v8.py refuses to overwrite V8_TEST_EVALUATION.json; no re-run after seeing results

known_limits_of_confirmatory_status: Programs authored in-repo by the project team, not an independent corpus; the v8 generator (max_names=1) and the entry policy were designed after the v6 edit-size confound was observed. The v8 DEV split was inspected and scored repeatedly during design.

The v8 test programs were never traced/scored before this freeze, but the exposure was: variant files of 4 test programs were diffed against regenerated variants while diagnosing the stale-variant defect (content only, no scores).
No pre-registration document for v8 existed before the dev dry-run; this file plus the evaluation script constitute the freeze, committed before the first test extraction.
26 programs (22 after exclusion) is a small number of clusters; cluster-bootstrap CIs may be anti-conservative.
tau_v8 is derived on 13 dev programs and affects operating-point numbers only, not AUROC.
